questions.cardText:
[Astronomy] What is the term for a group of stars forming a recognizable pattern that is traditionally named after its apparent form or identified with a mythological figure?
A. Galaxy
B. Nebula
C. Constellation
Answer: C.
questions.en: What is the term for a group of stars forming a recognizable pattern that is traditionally named after its apparent form or identified with a mythological figure?
questions.de: Wie nennt man eine Gruppe von Sternen, die ein erkennbares Muster bildet und traditionell nach ihrer Gestalt benannt oder mit einer mythologischen Figur gleichgesetzt wird?

timeline.labelEn: The International Astronomical Union adopts the modern list of 88 constellations
timeline.labelDe: Die Internationale Astronomische Union legt die moderne Liste der 88 Sternbilder fest

questions.notes: Today the IAU defines a constellation as an area of the sky; the star pattern itself is, strictly, an asterism. The card's traditional sense is kept.

questions.cardText:
[Astronomy] According to Apollo astronauts, what does the Moon smell like?
A. Wet soil
B. Burnt toast
C. Spent gunpowder
Answer: C. This description was made after they returned to the lunar module and could smell the lunar dust that had clung to their spacesuits. However, lunar dust samples brought back to Earth from the Moon are odorless, suggesting that the cause of the smell was temporary.
questions.en: According to the Apollo astronauts, what did the lunar dust clinging to their spacesuits smell like back in the lunar module?
questions.de: Wonach roch laut den Apollo-Astronauten der Mondstaub, der nach dem Ausstieg an ihren Raumanzügen in der Mondfähre haftete?

timeline.labelEn: The crewed Apollo Moon landings, from Apollo 11 to Apollo 17
timeline.labelDe: Die bemannten Apollo-Mondlandungen von Apollo 11 bis Apollo 17
